english.title: Large packaging producer fail to retain evidence of packaging waste collected and sent for recycling - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer subject to the data collection obligations of a large producer other than an online marketplace buyer or seller in relation to packaging specified in the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023, namely **(..SPECIFY PACKAGING..), failed to retain for 7 years evidence of how much

(A)_[relevant packaging waste you had collected during the data collection period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..) from other persons]_
(B)_[of the packaging waste collected during the data collection period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..) consisting of your own and other persons packaging waste was collected from each nation within the United Kingdom]_
(C)_[of the packaging waste collected during the data collection period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..) consisting of your own and other persons packaging waste was sent for recycling to another nation in the United Kingdom, identifying the nation concerned]_

declared by weight in kilograms and further broken down by packaging category
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(3)(b)(i) and 28(2)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a producer
subject to data collection obligations of a large producer
other than an online marketplace operator/seller
in relation to packaging specified in the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023
failed to retain for at least 7 years
evidence of how much
relevant packaging waste was collected from other persons and sent for recycling OR
packaging waste collected consisting of your own / other persons waste was collected from each nation within the UK OR
packaging waste collected consisting of your own / other persons waste was sent for recycling to another nation in the UK
during a relevant data collection period
being declared by weight in kg AND
further broken down by packaging category
